name: B10-0300/2025 (ECR) – Case of Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to release Ahmadreza Djalali, a Swedish-Iranian researcher held since 2016 and under a death sentence, and all others jailed on false charges. It condemns Iran's use of detained foreign and dual nationals as bargaining chips, and urges the European Union and its member states to build a joint strategy to counter this, including a task force to help detainees' families. It also condemns Iran's use of the death penalty to silence dissent.

- The report asks Iran to free Djalali and other prisoners; nothing changes automatically.
- It affects detained European and dual nationals in Iran and their families.
- Next: the EU and member states are urged to set up a task force on Iran.
